articles.title: U.S.- China AI race heats up as Chinese rivals secure billions ahead of IPOs
articles.snippet: DeepSeek and Moonshot attract fresh capital ahead of planned listings, while OpenAI courts major investors.

articles.title: U.S. scraps proposed $10,000 reporting rule for for crypto sent to private wallets
articles.snippet: FinCEN withdrew two proposals that had hung over self-custody and crypto mixers for years without ever taking effect.

articles.title: Solana Foundation unveils a program to settle institutional trades in seconds. JPMorgan gave input
articles.snippet: Solana Foundation launched an open-source program that lets institutions settle trades in seconds, not days. JPMorgan provided key inputs.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC joins SEC in proposing crypto regulations, though spot-market gap lingers
articles.snippet: The derivatives regulator is proposing two rules meant to cover the waterfront of crypto activity and exchanges, as long as it's not simple, direct trading.

articles.title: Winklevoss-backed Zcash ETF files with SEC for Nasdaq listing
articles.snippet: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, with Gemini Trust serving as custodian and Winklevoss Capital affiliates eyeing up to a $100 million investment.
